+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+DEFAULT_MODEL_FAMILY = "gpt-5"
+DEFAULT_MODEL_ID = "openai/gpt-5.4-mini"
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class ModelConfig:
+    api_key: Optional[str] = None
+    base_url: Optional[str] = None
+    model_family: str = DEFAULT_MODEL_FAMILY
+    model_id: str = DEFAULT_MODEL_ID
+
+
+def load_model_config() -> ModelConfig:
+    return ModelConfig(
+        api_key=os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY"),
+        base_url=os.getenv("OPENAI_BASE_URL"),
+        model_family=os.getenv("MODEL_FAMILY", DEFAULT_MODEL_FAMILY),
+        model_id=os.getenv("MODEL_ID", DEFAULT_MODEL_ID),
+    )
+
+
+def resolve_model_id(model_family: Optional[str] = None, model_id: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
+    if model_id:
+        return model_id
+    family = (model_family or os.getenv("MODEL_FAMILY") or DEFAULT_MODEL_FAMILY).strip().lower()
+    if family in {"gpt-5", "gpt5"}:
+        return os.getenv("MODEL_ID", DEFAULT_MODEL_ID)
+    if family in {"gpt-4.1", "gpt4.1", "gpt-4", "gpt4"}:
+        return os.getenv("MODEL_ID", "openai/gpt-4.1")
+    return os.getenv("MODEL_ID", DEFAULT_MODEL_ID)
+
+
+def build_client(config: Optional[ModelConfig] = None) -> OpenAI:
+    cfg = config or load_model_config()
+    kwargs: Dict[str, Any] = {}
+    if cfg.api_key:
+        kwargs["api_key"] = cfg.api_key
+    if cfg.base_url:
+        kwargs["base_url"] = cfg.base_url
+    return OpenAI(**kwargs)
+
+
+def complete_chat(
+    messages: Any,
+    *,
+    model_family: Optional[str] = None,
+    model_id: Optional[str] = None,
+    temperature: float = 0.2,
+    max_output_tokens: Optional[int] = None,
+    config: Optional[ModelConfig] = None,
+    **kwargs: Any,
+) -> Any:
+    cfg = config or load_model_config()
+    client = build_client(cfg)
+    resolved_model = resolve_model_id(model_family=model_family or cfg.model_family, model_id=model_id or cfg.model_id)
+    payload: Dict[str, Any] = {
+        "model": resolved_model,
+        "messages": messages,
+        "temperature": temperature,
+        **kwargs,
+    }
+    if max_output_tokens is not None:
+        payload["max_output_tokens"] = max_output_tokens
+    return client.chat.completions.create(**payload)
+
+
+def get_default_model_family() -> str:
+    return os.getenv("MODEL_FAMILY", DEFAULT_MODEL_FAMILY)
+
+
+def get_default_model_id() -> str:
+    return resolve_model_id()
*** End Patch

+import os
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+def stream_completion(prompt: str, model: str = "gpt-4.1-mini"):
+    client = OpenAI(api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
+    stream = client.responses.create(model=model, input=prompt, stream=True)
+    for event in stream:
+        if event.type == "response.output_text.delta":
+            delta = getattr(event, "delta", None)
+            if delta:
+                print(delta, end="", flush=True)
+        elif event.type == "response.completed":
+            break
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    import sys
+
+    prompt_text = " ".join(sys.argv[1:]).strip()
+    if not prompt_text:
+        raise SystemExit("Usage: python stream_completion.py <prompt>")
+    stream_completion(prompt_text)
*** End Patch

+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+def extract_json(text: str, schema_hint: str | None = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    client = OpenAI(api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
+    prompt = "Extract the requested structured JSON from the text. Return only valid JSON."
+    if schema_hint:
+        prompt = f"{prompt} Schema hint: {schema_hint}"
+    response = client.responses.create(
+        model="gpt-5.4-mini",
+        input=[
+            {
+                "role": "system",
+                "content": "You extract structured data and output only JSON.",
+            },
+            {
+                "role": "user",
+                "content": f"{prompt}\n\nText:\n{text}",
+            },
+        ],
+        response_format={"type": "json_object"},
+    )
+    output_text = response.output_text
+    return json.loads(output_text)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    import sys
+
+    source_text = sys.stdin.read()
+    result = extract_json(source_text)
+    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False))
*** End Patch

+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+def extract_json(text: str, schema_hint: str | None = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    client = OpenAI(api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
+    prompt = "Extract the requested structured JSON from the text. Return only valid JSON."
+    if schema_hint:
+        prompt = f"{prompt} Schema hint: {schema_hint}"
+    response = client.responses.create(
+        model="gpt-5.4-mini",
+        input=[
+            {
+                "role": "system",
+                "content": "You extract structured data and output only JSON.",
+            },
+            {
+                "role": "user",
+                "content": f"{prompt}\n\nText:\n{text}",
+            },
+        ],
+        response_format={"type": "json_object"},
+    )
+    output_text = response.output_text
+    return json.loads(output_text)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    import sys
+
+    source_text = sys.stdin.read()
+    result = extract_json(source_text)
+    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False))
